data: synthetic; 64 distinct valid emails, table people(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, email TEXT NOT NULL)

measurement.process: real CLI child process (re-exec of the test binary through main.run)
measurement.rss: /proc/<pid>/status VmHWM polled every 50 ms; only the apply phase is reported; short phases are under-sampled and omitted
measurement.timing: wall clock around each child invocation; scan/preview/approve/apply/validate are separate processes; fixture creation and file copies are outside all timed phases
measurement.heap: not available for the child process; the runner-level harness records Go heap (see docs/perf/issue13-wp3-a4a2e41)

commands: MASKRIVER_WP3F_CLI_SCALE=1 MASKRIVER_WP3F_SCALE_DIR=/tmp/wp3f-cli MASKRIVER_WP3F_CLI_ROWS=10000,100000,1000000 MASKRIVER_WP3F_CLI_REPEATS=5 go test ./cmd/maskriver -run TestCLIStreamingScaleEvidence -count=1 -timeout 90m
notes: 10k: 5 samples per configuration; 100k and 1M: 3 samples per configuration.
Each sample re-copies the pristine source to a fresh target and uses a distinct RunID.
The apply phase includes rebuilding the plan inside the CLI process, so it is not a pure database-write measurement.
Peak RSS is process-wide and includes the Go runtime, the pure-Go SQLite driver and page cache touched by the process.
